name: pro-2-subagents
description: Same tier assignment as Pro, but every fan-out is capped at two concurrent subagents.
notes: Set the Host subagent setting maxActiveSubagents to 2 to match; the kit cannot write Host settings for you.
Explorer and researcher still run together: they are the only two nodes that run in parallel, so the cap of 2 is not reached twice over.
Choose this on constrained accounts or to keep review and integration honest while agents are few.
